remarks: Looking for a peaceful riverfront home with private access to the Saugatuck River? This fully furnished rental in desirable South Wilton offers the perfect mix of charm, comfort, and convenience, surrounded by stunning nature. Imagine starting your day with beautiful river views, relaxing on the deck or screened-in porch, and soaking in the sounds of the water and wildlife. The main level features a cozy bedroom, a full bath, and a family room with gorgeous river views-perfect for relaxing or hosting. Upstairs, the primary suite feels like a private retreat, complete with an ensuite bath, walk-in closet, and serene views. You'll also find a third bedroom, an office/den, and another full bath upstairs. On the lower level, there's a spacious living and dining area, a well-equipped kitchen, a half bath, and a laundry room. With convenient NYC access, just minutes from Westport, Weston, and everything Lower Fairfield County has to offer, this home is available for long-term rental (12-24 months) or as the perfect summer getaway at $12,000/m for June, July, and August. Flexible terms may be considered. An opportunity like this is rare-come see it before it's gone!
